title: x402 Treasury Experiments
description: Pre-registered measurements of the cost and friction of converting accumulated L2 USDC micropayment revenue into spendable fiat. Each experiment is committed before it runs: a protocol and operator runbook are fixed in git, raw observations are collected verbatim into sessions, and the analyzed record validates against a published schema. The usdc-fiat-sweep-api experiment converted 8 tranches totaling USD 157.25908 to USD via the Coinbase Advanced Trade convert API: the convert fee quoted and charged was USD 0.00, the realized fee was 0.00%, and the USD spread was 0% on every tranche from 1 to the full wallet balance; the only realized cost was Base gas, 0.00000654 ETH spent from a 0.00014 ETH (approximately USD 0.31) funding float. On-chain transfer values were verified against Base mainnet at wei precision. Includes the pre-registered protocol and runbook, the 9 run records (8 executed, 1 pre-registered not_executed) with verbatim raw API artifacts, the frozen figure recipes, and the figures (the fee-decomposition figure is intentionally absent because every cost component is zero).
